summary: Recorded a negative result that the run had investigated early but never written down, so the account shows an excluded candidate as well as the asserted defects. The suspect is the handlePreAccept branch at epaxos/epaxos.go:807-813, which writes the incoming command into the row of preAccept.LeaderId at the instance index - a different instance's slot whenever a recovering coordinator sends the message - and which would panic if that slot were nil. Tracing every writer of instance status in the package shows its premise is not produced: startPhase1 always installs a command (state.NOOP() for recoveries), handlePreAccept sets the command and the status in the same branch, handlePreAcceptReply and handleTryPreAcceptReply carry non-nil bookkeeping commands, handleTryPreAccept sets the command before the status, and an acceptor that never pre-accepted reports status NONE rather than ACCEPTED because handleAccept records only deps, seq and ballots. The suspicion is therefore registered under its own explained question with the defect claim refuted, scoped explicitly to these writers in this snapshot, with counterevidence (a durable restart reconstructing state would defeat the premise, and handleAccept's missing ACCEPTED status is where a corrected protocol would make the premise easier to reach) and limits (source-only account, no execution exercised the branch, and the mis-indexing was not exercised even in the owner case). A new behavior entry records the status/command invariant with three new source ranges, and the four explained questions with their three asserted defects and one holds account remain unchanged.
